violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities
violation_type.typical_finding: Children where observed watching cartoons while combined in the gym.

finding_variants.text: Children where observed watching cartoons while combined in the gym.
During the inspection it was observed that the pre k classroom was watching the cartoon Resses. This cartoon was not related to their planned activities or meeting educational goals.

Screen time was being provided to children in the toddler room after the afternoon snack. The children were observed watching a minion game not related to the planned activities that meet educational goals.

3 children were observed to be using electronic devices for purposes not related to planned activities.       NOTE: This was corrected by devices being put away and caregiver transitioning to a planned activity.
This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance through an investigation when multiple caregivers stated they would watch Disney movies not related to planned activates.
Child were observed playing video games in the school age classroom.    This was corrected when director turned off the tv.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: During the walk-through, CCR observed school-age children watching YouTube on television, which did not meet educational goals, as well as children playing video games on their phones and tablets.

Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: The screen time displayed for the toddler group (25months-36 months of age) was not part of the activity plan. The activity plan in the toddler room did not have a date.
Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Children in care were allowed to play video games. These games are not related to the planned activities and do not meet educational goals.

Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: A three year old was seen playing on an iPad during puzzle time. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver took the iPad away from the child.

Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Upon arrival, 1 child in care was observed on a screen time devices.     NOTE: According to the director, the child had recently turned on the device prior to CCR's entry into the facility.     NOTE: This was corrected when the child powered off the device and put it away.

Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Four children were observed to be watching their personal tablets while the remaining children in the class watched a television.   There was no observed planned activity related to the usage of the screens.
Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: The operation was allowing children to be on personal devices to utilize that was not related to planned activities for the center.
